scripts.build: npm run build -w @sausixudos/shared && npm run build -w @sausixudos/api && npm run build -w @sausixudos/web && npm run build -w @sausixudos/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sausixudos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sausixudos/api && npm run typecheck -w @sausixudos/web && npm run typecheck -w @sausixudos/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sausixudos/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @sausixudos/api" "npm run dev -w @sausixudos/web"
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build -w @sausixudos/shared && concurrently -k -s first -n api,web,desktop -c blue,magenta,green "cross-env NODE_ENV=development WEB_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5173 COOKIE_SECURE=false LIVEKIT_PUBLIC_URL=ws://localhost:5173/livekit LIVEKIT_INTERNAL_URL=http://localhost:7880 npm run dev -w @sausixudos/api" "npm run dev -w @sausixudos/web" "npm run dev -w @sausixudos/desktop"
